query:
UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Mohamed Diab, Justin Benson, Aaron Moorhead (showrunner: Jeremy Slater)',
  `cast` = 'Oscar Isaac as Marc Spector / Steven Grant / Moon Knight, Ethan Hawke as Arthur Harrow, May Calamawy as Layla El-Faouly / Scarlet Scarab, F. Murray Abraham as Khonshu (voice)',
  tagline = 'Embrace the chaos. Oscar Isaac delivers a tour-de-force performance as Marvel''s most complex hero.',
  description = 'Moon Knight follows Steven Grant, a mild-mannered gift shop employee who discovers he shares a body with mercenary Marc Spector, and together they must navigate Egyptian gods, dangerous cults, and their own fractured psyche.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/moon-knight-featured-QhNmL5zxCAFCg2upsojXPZ.webp',
  episodeCount = 6, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 87, rtAudienceScore = 87, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Moon Knight Cards: The Oscar Isaac Premium

Moon Knight cards benefit from Oscar Isaac''s A-list status and the character''s cult following. The **2023 Upper Deck Moon Knight** set features stunning Egyptian-themed artwork. Moon Knight has always been a collector favorite in comics, and his MCU debut elevated card values significantly. Khonshu cards with unique skeletal bird imagery are particularly eye-catching.',
  keyCards = '- **2023 Upper Deck Moon Knight Oscar Isaac Base** — A-list actor MCU debut, $10-25
- **2023 Upper Deck Moon Knight Mr. Knight Suit** — The iconic white suit card, $8-20
- **2023 Upper Deck Moon Knight Khonshu** — Unique character design card, $5-15
- **2023 Upper Deck Moon Knight Oscar Isaac Auto** — Premium autograph, $150-350+',
  content = '## Oscar Isaac''s Masterclass

Oscar Isaac playing multiple personalities — sometimes switching mid-scene — was the kind of performance that transcends the superhero genre. His Steven Grant (bumbling British gift shop worker) and Marc Spector (hardened mercenary) were so distinct that you forgot they were the same actor. It was a performance worthy of prestige television.

## Egyptian Mythology Meets Marvel

Moon Knight brought Egyptian mythology into the MCU with respect and spectacle. The show filmed partially in Egypt, consulted with Egyptian filmmakers, and treated the mythology as living culture rather than ancient artifact. May Calamawy''s Layla becoming the Scarlet Scarab was a landmark moment for Egyptian representation.

## Mental Health Representation

The show''s portrayal of Dissociative Identity Disorder, while dramatized for superhero storytelling, was praised for treating Marc''s condition with empathy rather than as a plot gimmick. The asylum episode exploring Marc''s trauma was one of the most emotionally devastating hours of Marvel television.

## Fun Facts

- Oscar Isaac learned to do a British accent specifically for Steven Grant
- The show was largely standalone with no other MCU characters appearing
- Ethan Hawke based Arthur Harrow on cult leader David Koresh
- The hippo goddess Taweret became an unexpected fan-favorite
- A third personality, Jake Lockley, was teased in the post-credits scene',
  metaDescription = 'Moon Knight (2022) guide — Oscar Isaac dual performance, Egyptian mythology, mental health themes, trading card values, and why this standalone show stands apart.',
  keywords = 'moon knight, oscar isaac, marc spector, steven grant, khonshu, egyptian mythology, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, ethan hawke',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Moon Knight Oscar Isaac cards',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Moon Knight connected to the rest of the MCU?","answer":"Moon Knight is largely standalone with no other MCU heroes appearing. However, it exists within the MCU and references to the broader universe confirm its place in the timeline."},{"question":"Does Moon Knight have multiple personalities?","answer":"Yes, the show features Marc Spector and Steven Grant as two distinct personalities sharing one body, with a third personality (Jake Lockley) teased in the post-credits scene."},{"question":"Will there be a Moon Knight Season 2?","answer":"While not officially confirmed as of 2025, Oscar Isaac has expressed interest in returning and the character is expected to appear in future MCU projects."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'moon-knight-2022'
